---
title: "Our Team"
---

```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(glue)

# Read team data once at the beginning
team <- read_csv("data/team-members.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

Our work on the **POPCORN-NCD Reporting Guideline** is led by an international collaborative group committed to transparency and rigour in simulation modelling research. Our team brings together expertise from diverse regions, disciplines, and stakeholder perspectives.

[Learn more about our development process →](3-process.qmd)

## Strategic Advisory Committee

<!--
COORDINATOR: SAC is AUTO-GENERATED from data/team-members.csv

To add/update members:
1. Open Google Sheet with team member data
2. Add/edit rows where strategic_advisory_cmt is NOT "NA" or blank
3. The sync script will update data/team-members.csv automatically

CSV Columns needed: first_name, last_name, post_nominal_initials, affiliation_primary,
affiliation_2, affiliation_3, affiliation_4, strategic_advisory_cmt, ORCID, web_bio
-->

Our Strategic Advisory Committee provides expert guidance on the development and implementation of POPCORN-NCD reporting guidelines. Members represent diverse geographical regions, methodological expertise, and stakeholder perspectives.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

# Filter for SAC members (where strategic_advisory_cmt is not NA or empty)
sac <- team %>%
  filter(!is.na(strategic_advisory_cmt) &
         strategic_advisory_cmt != "" &
         strategic_advisory_cmt != "NA" &
         strategic_advisory_cmt != ".") %>%
  # Create sort order: Chair → Members → Ex Officio → PIs → Staff
  mutate(
    role_order = case_when(
      grepl("Chair", strategic_advisory_cmt, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ 1,
      grepl("Member", strategic_advisory_cmt, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ 2,
      grepl("Ex Officio", strategic_advisory_cmt, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ 3,
      grepl("Principal Investigator|Co-Principal", strategic_advisory_cmt, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ 4,
      grepl("Staff", strategic_advisory_cmt, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ 5,
      TRUE ~ 6  # Catch-all for any other roles
    )
  ) %>%
  # Sort by role order, then alphabetically by last name
  arrange(role_order, last_name)

if (nrow(sac) > 0) {
  cat('<div class="team-list">\n\n')

  for (i in 1:nrow(sac)) {
    # Start member div
    cat('<div class="team-member">\n\n')

    # Left column: Name and credentials
    cat('<div class="member-name-col">\n')
    cat(sac$first_name[i], ' ', sac$last_name[i], '\n', sep='')
    if (!is.na(sac$post_nominal_initials[i]) && sac$post_nominal_initials[i] != "") {
      cat('<div class="member-credentials">', sac$post_nominal_initials[i], '</div>\n', sep='')
    }
    cat('</div>\n\n')

    # Right column: Details
    cat('<div class="member-details-col">\n\n')

    # Affiliations (combine non-empty affiliations with semicolons)
    affiliations <- c(
      sac$affiliation_primary[i],
      sac$affiliation_2[i],
      sac$affiliation_3[i],
      sac$affiliation_4[i]
    )
    affiliations <- affiliations[!is.na(affiliations) & affiliations != ""]

    if (length(affiliations) > 0) {
      cat('<div class="member-affiliation">', paste(affiliations, collapse='; '), '</div>\n\n', sep='')
    }

    # SAC role (just the role name, not full description)
    if (!is.na(sac$strategic_advisory_cmt[i]) && sac$strategic_advisory_cmt[i] != "") {
      cat('<div class="member-role">', sac$strategic_advisory_cmt[i], '</div>\n\n', sep='')
    }

    # Links (ORCID and Web bio)
    links <- character(0)

    if (!is.na(sac$ORCID[i]) && sac$ORCID[i] != "" && sac$ORCID[i] != "NA") {
      links <- c(links, paste0('<a href="https://orcid.org/', sac$ORCID[i], '"><img src="assets/icons/orcid.svg" class="inline-icon" alt="ORCID"> ORCID</a>'))
    }

    if (!is.na(sac$web_bio[i]) && sac$web_bio[i] != "") {
      links <- c(links, paste0('<a href="', sac$web_bio[i], '">Web bio</a>'))
    }

    if (length(links) > 0) {
      cat('<div class="member-links">', paste(links, collapse=' '), '</div>\n', sep='')
    }

    cat('</div>\n\n')  # Close details column
    cat('</div>\n\n')  # Close member div
  }

  cat('</div>\n\n')  # Close team-list
} else {
  cat('*Members to be announced.*\n\n')
}
```

## Investigators and collaborators

CSV Columns needed: first_name, last_name, post_nominal_initials, affiliation_primary,

-->

Our team of investigators and collaborators brings together expertise in population health modelling, clinical epidemiology, knowledge translation, and health services research. Investigators contribute to study design, methodology, analysis, and knowledge dissemination. Collaborators provide specialized expertise and facilitate knowledge exchange across research networks and practice settings.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

# Filter for investigators/collaborators (where cihr_study is not NA or empty)
investigators <- team %>%
  filter(!is.na(cihr_study) &
         cihr_study != "" &
         cihr_study != "NA" &
         cihr_study != ".") %>%
  # Sort alphabetically by last name
  arrange(last_name)

if (nrow(investigators) > 0) {
  cat('<div class="team-list">\n\n')

  for (i in 1:nrow(investigators)) {
    # Start member div
    cat('<div class="team-member">\n\n')

    # Left column: Name and credentials
    cat('<div class="member-name-col">\n')
    cat(investigators$first_name[i], ' ', investigators$last_name[i], '\n', sep='')
    if (!is.na(investigators$post_nominal_initials[i]) && investigators$post_nominal_initials[i] != "") {
      cat('<div class="member-credentials">', investigators$post_nominal_initials[i], '</div>\n', sep='')
    }
    cat('</div>\n\n')

    # Right column: Details
    cat('<div class="member-details-col">\n\n')

    # Affiliations (combine non-empty affiliations with semicolons)
    affiliations <- c(
      investigators$affiliation_primary[i],
      investigators$affiliation_2[i],
      investigators$affiliation_3[i],
      investigators$affiliation_4[i]
    )
    affiliations <- affiliations[!is.na(affiliations) & affiliations != ""]

    if (length(affiliations) > 0) {
      cat('<div class="member-affiliation">', paste(affiliations, collapse='; '), '</div>\n\n', sep='')
    }

    # CIHR study role
    if (!is.na(investigators$cihr_study[i]) && investigators$cihr_study[i] != "") {
      cat('<div class="member-role">', investigators$cihr_study[i], '</div>\n\n', sep='')
    }

    # Links (ORCID and Web bio)
    links <- character(0)

    if (!is.na(investigators$ORCID[i]) && investigators$ORCID[i] != "" && investigators$ORCID[i] != "NA") {
      links <- c(links, paste0('<a href="https://orcid.org/', investigators$ORCID[i], '"><img src="assets/icons/orcid.svg" class="inline-icon" alt="ORCID"> ORCID</a>'))
    }

    if (!is.na(investigators$web_bio[i]) && investigators$web_bio[i] != "") {
      links <- c(links, paste0('<a href="', investigators$web_bio[i], '">Web bio</a>'))
    }

    if (length(links) > 0) {
      cat('<div class="member-links">', paste(links, collapse=' '), '</div>\n', sep='')
    }

    cat('</div>\n\n')  # Close details column
    cat('</div>\n\n')  # Close member div
  }

  cat('</div>\n\n')  # Close team-list
} else {
  cat('*Team members to be announced.*\n\n')
}
```

## Study team

<!--
COORDINATOR: Study team is AUTO-GENERATED from data/team-members.csv

To add/update members:
1. Open Google Sheet with team member data
2. Set study_team = "Yes" for team members
3. The sync script will update data/team-members.csv automatically

CSV Columns needed: first_name, last_name, post_nominal_initials, affiliation_primary,
affiliation_2, affiliation_3, affiliation_4, study_team (Yes/No), ORCID, web_bio
-->

The POPCORN-NCD study team manages the day-to-day research activities, coordinates working groups, facilitates stakeholder engagement, and ensures the successful implementation of all project components. This dedicated team drives the project forward through research coordination, knowledge synthesis, stakeholder consultation, and guideline development.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

# Filter for study team (where study_team is "Yes" or "active")
study_team <- team %>%
  filter(!is.na(study_team) &
         (study_team == "Yes" | study_team == "active")) %>%
  # Sort alphabetically by last name
  arrange(last_name)

if (nrow(study_team) > 0) {
  cat('<div class="team-list">\n\n')

  for (i in 1:nrow(study_team)) {
    # Start member div
    cat('<div class="team-member">\n\n')

    # Left column: Name and credentials
    cat('<div class="member-name-col">\n')
    cat(study_team$first_name[i], ' ', study_team$last_name[i], '\n', sep='')
    if (!is.na(study_team$post_nominal_initials[i]) && study_team$post_nominal_initials[i] != "") {
      cat('<div class="member-credentials">', study_team$post_nominal_initials[i], '</div>\n', sep='')
    }
    cat('</div>\n\n')

    # Right column: Details
    cat('<div class="member-details-col">\n\n')

    # Affiliations (combine non-empty affiliations with semicolons)
    affiliations <- c(
      study_team$affiliation_primary[i],
      study_team$affiliation_2[i],
      study_team$affiliation_3[i],
      study_team$affiliation_4[i]
    )
    affiliations <- affiliations[!is.na(affiliations) & affiliations != ""]

    if (length(affiliations) > 0) {
      cat('<div class="member-affiliation">', paste(affiliations, collapse='; '), '</div>\n\n', sep='')
    }

    # No role for study team - just affiliations and links

    # Links (ORCID and Web bio)
    links <- character(0)

    if (!is.na(study_team$ORCID[i]) && study_team$ORCID[i] != "" && study_team$ORCID[i] != "NA") {
      links <- c(links, paste0('<a href="https://orcid.org/', study_team$ORCID[i], '"><img src="assets/icons/orcid.svg" class="inline-icon" alt="ORCID"> ORCID</a>'))
    }

    if (!is.na(study_team$web_bio[i]) && study_team$web_bio[i] != "") {
      links <- c(links, paste0('<a href="', study_team$web_bio[i], '">Web bio</a>'))
    }

    if (length(links) > 0) {
      cat('<div class="member-links">', paste(links, collapse=' '), '</div>\n', sep='')
    }

    cat('</div>\n\n')  # Close details column
    cat('</div>\n\n')  # Close member div
  }

  cat('</div>\n\n')  # Close team-list
} else {
  cat('*Team members to be announced.*\n\n')
}
```
